Chapter 293: Chapter 4: The Second Physical Body Divine Ability (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

“`

It belonged to Fang Qing.

After all, who didn’t know that Fang Qing had stepped forward to help when Shisan, the Peak Master, was hiding his identity?

No matter what.

In the Chikun Lineage.

Fang Qing was already considered a person of the Shisan Peak Master.

...

Even those core members of the Chikun Lineage treated Fang Qing with utmost respect.

“Hahahaha…”

Lin Yuan laughed out loud.

Before Lin Yuan had revealed his identity, there were people who went to great lengths to get in touch with Fang Qing through him.

Now, there were also people who were scheming hard to get close to him through Fang Qing.

The drastic change from then to now made Lin Yuan quite reflective.

“Shisan Peak is just established, would you like to come help me?”

Lin Yuan chatted with Fang Qing for a while before mentioning this casually.

Everyone knew that joining Shisan Peak now was the same as being among the first to pledge allegiance to the Shisan Peak Master, and in the future, they would all be considered senior members.

“Thank you, Big Brother Lin.”

Upon hearing this, Fang Qing immediately stood up and bowed respectfully.

The weight of Lin Yuan’s words was no different from giving Fang Qing an opportunity to rise to the heavens in one step within the Chikun Lineage.

What could be more honorable than becoming a confidant, or even a direct subordinate, under the Peak Master?

…

After chatting with Lin Yuan,

Fang Qing returned to his personal space.

“Fang lad.”

“What did I tell you before? Your Big Brother Lin is destined for boundless prospects.”

The old man with a white beard said proudly.

As an intelligent life form, the old man with a white beard didn’t have much strength, but his insight was extremely sharp.

“From now on, just follow behind your Big Brother Lin and devote yourself to serving him well; don’t think about managing anything else, understand?”

The white-bearded old man reminded him.

He was fully aware that cultivation fanatics like Lin Yuan generally wouldn’t bother with too many things.

But if Fang Qing tried to take advantage of this to gain something for himself, it would be a huge mistake.

“I understand.”

Fang Qing nodded.

As one of the first members to join Shisan Peak, it was not difficult for Fang Qing to be promoted to a core member of the Chikun Lineage.

With such a great opportunity, if Fang Qing still thought about other benefits, he truly would be unworthy of Big Brother Lin’s trust.

“Cultivate well.”

“Your current head start has already far surpassed that of the old master…”

The old man with a white beard’s voice suddenly became somber.

His old master, the Sixth Rank Fallen Star Warrior, had some renown in the Chikun Star Domain and the surrounding star domains.

But how could that compare to Fang Qing now? Being under a big tree provides good shade, and even more so with Shisan Peak Master, who was like a towering tree.

…

Virtual World.

Personal Space.

Lin Yuan opened his personal settlement panel.

“The profit distribution from the Martial Path Evolutionary Path settlement…”

Lin Yuan glanced at the final amount.

“Two hundred eighty-nine trillion six hundred ninety billion civilization coins?”

“This much?”

Lin Yuan was a bit surprised.

The unit was in billions; two hundred eighty thousand billion, nearly three hundred trillion in enormous wealth.

“Mainly because the Sixth Rank Chapter has made another strong push….”

Lin Yuan looked over the sales numbers of each rank chapter.

He noticed that the Sixth Rank Chapter had been purchased over a thousand times.

You have to know, the price Lin Yuan set for the Sixth Rank Chapter was fifty billion.

A Fifty-billion-priced Sixth Rank Chapter, purchased over a thousand times, amounted to fifty trillion.

After adding Lin Yuan’s 30/70 split with human civilization and subtracting taxes, the final take-home was close to two hundred trillion.

“The Sixth Rank Chapter was bought over a thousand times, mostly out of curiosity. As for those who are actually cultivating to the pinnacle of the Fifth Rank and planning to buy the Sixth Rank Chapter, there are none…”

Lin Yuan was well aware of how the thousand-plus purchases came about.

The Martial Dao Cultivation Evolution Path’s ranking on the Chikun Evolution Rankings had soared, thought to be the work of a certain Evolutionary scholar.

Naturally, it aroused the curiosity of many High-Rank Evolvers.

Therefore, every time Lin Yuan updated the latest chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, there would be a bunch of Evolvers who would directly purchase it to take a look.

Their reasons for purchasing were likely not for cultivation but out of pure curiosity, wanting to see why the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had such potential.

“It’s still too early.”

“If a hundred or two hundred years go by, and within the Martial Arts Evolutionaries, Fourth and Fifth Ranks emerge, that will be the time when the Sixth Rank Chapter will be in its prime.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

“`

“`

A moment of curiosity cannot generate a continuous stream of income.

But the wider the spread of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, the more evolving cultivators there are who practice it, the more it becomes a true mountain of gold.

“Thirty trillion…”

“And that’s just the income from one settlement.”

Lin Yuan glanced at his account balance and felt pleased.

Although with his strength and status, thirty trillion wasn’t much, for Lin Yuan, it was tantamount to a gift.

“I still need to push it a bit.”

After some thought, Lin Yuan made up his mind.

The evolution of martial arts cultivators is too slow nowadays, with most lacking guidance and thus, prone to taking the wrong path.

“Just so happens I’ve got some free time, I’ll make a few Martial Tao analysis videos…”

With a thought, Lin Yuan’s personal space began to change.

His appearance, body shape, and demeanor also began to transform accordingly.

In the end, an image of a slim man appeared.

“This should be good.”

Lin Yuan touched his chin.

He began explaining from the First Tier Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

The First Tier Chapter is the beginning of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, divided into the Innate Realm, Grand Master Realm, Grandmaster Realm, and so on.

Among the current martial arts evolutionaries, most are at the First Tier Chapter.

“As for Innate…”

Lin Yuan used only a few thousand words to introduce the Innate Chapter, then took just over ten minutes to elaborate in detail.

Time went by.

In just under half a day,

Lin Yuan successfully recorded more than ten videos.

Including parts of the First Tier Chapter, Second Layer Chapter, and Third Rank Chapter.

“This should be enough.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Reviewing the First Tier Chapter, the Second Layer Chapter, and the Third Rank Chapter was also quite helpful for Lin Yuan himself.

“Upload them to the Virtual World.”

Lin Yuan entered the Martial Path founder ‘Yuan’s account and uploaded the newly recorded set of analysis videos.

“So many followers already?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the number of followers ‘Yuan’ had, which exceeded a hundred billion.

You should know, these hundred billion followers are not ordinary citizens; those who can enter the Virtual World and watch ‘Yuan’ are either evolutionaries or high-grade citizens.

A hundred billion followers isn’t much less than some celebrity evolutionaries in the Chikun Star Domain.

“Completed.”

Just moments after Lin Yuan clicked upload,

more than a dozen analysis videos appeared under ‘Yuan’s account.

“I hope you guys won’t disappoint me.”

The more Martial Path Evolutionaries there are, especially the higher-ranked ones, the deeper Lin Yuan’s foundational accumulation in certain aspects becomes.

In the future ‘Ultimate Leap’, everything will be transformed into an overwhelming advantage.

…

After uploading the videos,

Lin Yuan didn’t pay them further attention.

Instead, he contemplated the remaining space models.

At the entry stage of Space Rules, out of 965 space models, Lin Yuan had grasped four-fifths of them.

The remaining dozens, demonstrated personally by the Chikun Star Lord, already somewhat understood by Lin Yuan with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, it’s only a matter of time before he completely grasps them.

“Grasping all 965 kinds of space models, entry into Space Rules should pave the way to ideally create the Seventh Rank Chapter…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

With just an entry-level understanding of Space, mixed with the Taiji Dao, to shape the Martial Path Evolutionary Path,

Lin Yuan felt that once stepping into the ideal state of the Seventh Rank, his strength would soar.

“Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path…”

When Lin Yuan tired of contemplating Space Rules, he began to contemplate other Evolutionary Paths.

Especially the space-related Evolution Paths, which are like certain imprints of the essence of Space Rules,

Understanding space-related Evolution Paths sometimes is no less profound than contemplating space models directly.

In addition.

Whenever Lin Yuan had spare time, he would contemplate the Dao of Taiyang and Taiyin, and the fire system Rule Crystal given to him by the Chikun Star Lord; Lin Yuan had not yet fully grasped it, each observation brought a different feeling.

Time passed by.

Two days went by in the blink of an eye.

While Lin Yuan was still engrossed in his cultivation and Dao enlightenment,

a ripple that only Lin Yuan could perceive slowly spread out from the depths of his bloodline.

“Is my Second Physical Body Divine Ability about to take shape?”

Lin Yuan immediately stopped his practice and focused on the changes in his body.

“My second Physical Body Divine Ability…”

With the experience from the first time his Physical Body Divine Ability took shape, Lin Yuan was quite adept, carefully experiencing the odd power from the depths of his bloodline.
